lines.en: label nodokaspring1:
scene nodokaoutside1
I knock on Nodoka’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Nodoka 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I figure that, if she’s going to get in on this whole apocalypse deal, it’s probably best if I give her some orientation.
lines.zh: 我心想，如果她要掺和进这整套末日的事，那我最好还是先给她做点「入职培训」。

lines.en: And by “orientation,” I mean penis.
lines.zh: 而我说的「培训」，指的是阴茎。

lines.en: What I’m saying is that I am here to have sex with her.
lines.zh: 我想说的是，我是来跟她做爱的。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside2
: Oh. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦。你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Darn it. Looks like I’ll just have to have sex with Otoha instead.
lines.zh: : 该死。看来我只好转而跟 Otoha 做爱了。

lines.en: : Why? Do you have some sort of quota you need to fill by the end of the day or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你是有什么今天结束前必须填满的配额之类的吗？

lines.en: : As she stood there in those pajamas, which made her like five times more attractive than normal, I thought to myself, “Is it really {i}her{/i} I’m after? Or just the thrill of chasing after an unobtainable goal?”
lines.zh: : 当{i}她{/i}穿着那身睡衣站在那儿——那让她比平时好看了五倍——我心里想：「我追的真的是她吗？还是说只是追逐一个不可得的目标时那份刺激？」

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside3
: Damn, five times? Really? I figured it was like three at best.
lines.zh: : 该死，五倍？真的假的？我最多以为三倍。

lines.en: : But as she gazed down at her own figure instead of mine, I knew that the answer was “neither.” And that I truly {i}was{/i} living out the rest of my existence in a hell of my own creation.
lines.zh: : 但当她低头凝视的是自己的身段、而不是我的，我就知道答案是「都不是」。而我{i}确实{/i}是在自己亲手创造的地狱里，度过余下的存在。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside4
: You done?
lines.zh: : 说完了吗？

lines.en: : {i}The end.{/i} Now, I’m done. Where’s Nodoka?
lines.zh: : {i}全文完{/i}。现在我说完了。Nodoka 在哪儿？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Home, probably. Why?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概在家吧。怎么了？

lines.en: : You don’t know?
lines.zh: : 你不知道？

lines.en: : I’m her roommate, not her babysitter. I think you’ve confused {i}our{/i} dynamic with Dorm 9’s.
lines.zh: : 我是她室友，不是她的保姆。你大概是把{i}我们{/i}的关系跟 9 号宿舍的搞混了。

lines.en: : Nodoka needs a babysitter just as badly as Yasu and you know it.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 需要保姆的程度，跟 Yasu 一样迫切，这一点你心知肚明。

lines.en: : Oh, chill. I’m sure she’s just fine wherever she is right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，别激动。我相信她现在不管在哪儿都好好的。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside5
: WHERE THE FUCK AM I AND HOW DID I GET HERE?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈到底在哪儿、我是怎么到这儿来的？！

lines.en: {i}She was not fine.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她一点都不好。{/i}

lines.en: For, once more, she had escaped the boundaries of the hit 2020 video game “Lessons in Love” and found herself in the loading screen of something else.
lines.zh: 因为，她再一次逃出了 2020 年大热电子游戏《Lessons in Love》的边界，发现自己身处某个别的东西的加载画面里。

lines.en: It was a place where things were, somehow, even worse. A slice of life you’d never want on your plate, where the reception was so bad that you couldn’t even slap a denpa sticker on it and call it a day.
lines.zh: 那是一个不知怎么更糟的地方。一块你绝不想盛进盘子里的日常切片，那里的信号差到你甚至没法贴一张电波贴纸就敷衍了事。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside6
This perturbed her.
lines.zh: 这让她心烦意乱。

lines.en: : I’m so perturbed!
lines.zh: : 我好心烦意乱！

lines.en: , she thought to herself out loud because thoughts weren’t held to the same standards here that they are in areas where narration mostly makes cents.
lines.zh: ，她把念头大声说了出来——因为在这里，思想不必遵守那些「旁白大多讲得通」的地方所遵循的标准。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside7
A joke. I misspoke. It’s supposed to be “sense” and not “cents” like I wrote.
lines.zh: 一个笑话。我说错了。应该是「讲得通（sense）」，而不是我写的「几分钱（cents）」。

lines.en: {size=-2}Just sometimes it’s easier to showcase how wonky and crazy broken realities can be without the presence of some guy with squiggly eyes. So you rely on literary tricks like wordplay or swordplay and rewrite the way language works.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}只是有时候，在没有那个 squiggly eyes 家伙在场的情况下，要展现现实能有多么歪斜、多么疯狂地崩坏，靠文字游戏或刀剑游戏之类的文学把戏、重写语言的运作方式，会更容易些。{/size}

lines.en: It’s more complex and nuanced than just shifting where plurality resides, though, for that leaves nothing do with sword like deer or mouse. How can you fix what comes out of the box broken?
lines.zh: 但这比单纯挪动复数的位置要复杂微妙得多，因为那样对像鹿或老鼠之类的「剑」毫无作用。你要怎么修好一个从盒子里拿出来就是坏的东西？

lines.en: We all know the best course of action when that happens is to just send the box back to Amazon and complain until you get a new one. Did you know they’ll just do that now?
lines.zh: 我们都知道，遇到这种情况最好的办法就是把盒子寄回亚马逊，然后投诉到他们给你换一个新的。你知道他们现在真的会这么干吗？

lines.en: You can just lie and they’ll be like “okay” then send you back a whole new box of [[PENDING NOUN WITH REVERSED PLURALIZATION THAT WOULD MAKE THIS SENTENCE CLEVER AND FUNNY].
lines.zh: 你只要撒个谎，他们就会说「好的」，然后寄回一整盒崭新的 [[PENDING NOUN WITH REVERSED PLURALIZATION THAT WOULD MAKE THIS SENTENCE CLEVER AND FUNNY]。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside8
There were three things going through her head right now — thoughts, meat, and bone.
lines.zh: 此刻有三样东西在她脑子里打转——思想、肉、骨。

lines.en: Swimming through those thoughts, however, was a specific thought that I will now tell you about because I’ve finally figured it out after staring so deeply into unsquiggled squiggly eyes.
lines.zh: 然而，游过那些思想的，是一个特定的念头，我现在就要告诉你它是什么，因为在深深凝视过那双不再扭曲的 squiggly eyes 之后，我终于弄明白了。

lines.en: A memory. A premonition. Or perhaps something in between that would help her complete her mission.
lines.zh: 一段记忆。一个预感。或者介于两者之间的什么东西，能帮她完成她的使命。

lines.en: Like a dog, she was at her best when she was wet. Kind of like Number Girl in that TV show about all of those strange things who couldn’t use her powers unless she was taking a bath. What a great idea that was.
lines.zh: 像狗一样，她湿的时候状态最好。有点像那部讲的都是些怪事的电视剧里的 Number Girl——她不泡澡就没法使用能力。那真是个好点子。

lines.en: Anyway, the thought was this — run.
lines.zh: 总之，那个念头是这样的——跑。

lines.en: Not in the direction of where the bus goes, but the direction the bus is {i}supposed{/i} to go in because you can’t reach the past by going backward. You must lap it. Less like the dog and more like its dish.
lines.zh: 不是朝着公交车驶去的方向，而是朝着公交车{i}本该{/i}驶去的方向，因为你无法通过倒退抵达过去。你必须绕它一圈。少像那条狗，多像它的盘子。

lines.en: And so she would.
lines.zh: 于是她会这么做。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside9
And so she did.
lines.zh: 于是她做了。

lines.en: {size=-4}Now, here in this rectangular bathysphere holding out the pressure of persistence, she successfully avoided drowning and had come one step closer to firmly stroking an inkling until it dyes her cheeks black with the fruits of aroused elation.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}如今，在这个抵挡着「执着」之压的、长方形的深海潜水球里，她成功避免了溺死，并朝着「坚定地抚弄一丝预感、直到它用被唤起的狂喜之果把她脸颊染黑」又近了一步。{/size}

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside10
: Wha...
I have always been a dot. A speck. The kind you can’t get out. I rest in your subconscious thoughts, embedded in the grout.
lines.zh: 我向来是一个点。一粒斑点。那种弄不掉的。我栖息在你潜意识的思绪里，嵌在水泥缝里。

lines.en: I can’t be cleaned. I must be killed. No vinegar nor bleach can ever collect all the things you’ve dropped when in your reach.
lines.zh: 我无法被清洁。我必须被杀死。任何醋或漂白剂，都收集不全你伸手可及之处掉落的一切。

lines.en: Do you remember now?
lines.zh: 你现在想起来了吗？

lines.en: Where you are, Nodoka?
lines.zh: 你在哪儿，Nodoka？

lines.en: Where this {i}is?{/i}
lines.zh: 这{i}是{/i}哪儿？

lines.en: Your future. Your past. The halls where you were made and the halls where you will die.
lines.zh: 你的未来。你的过去。你被造出来的那些走廊，以及你将死在其中的那些走廊。

lines.en: Like the moon, it’s all one perfect circle.
lines.zh: 像月亮一样，那是一个完美的圆。

lines.en: Rest, my child. Be safe here in my womb.
lines.zh: 安息吧，我的孩子。在我的子宫里，你是安全的。

lines.en: : This...is not my school.
lines.zh: : 这……不是我的学校。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside11
: And class doesn’t start for {i}HOURS!{/i} I still have to BRUSH MY HAIR!!!!
lines.zh: : 而且离上课还有{i}好几个小时{/i}！我还得梳头呢！！！！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside12
: The library...
lines.zh: : 图书馆……

lines.en: : I must go to the library. I can wait there until tomorrow comes and explain to everyone that I have come here by means I am presently unaware of.
lines.zh: : 我必须去图书馆。我可以在那儿等到明天到来，然后向大家解释我是以某种我目前还不清楚的方式来到这儿的。

lines.en: : I am God. I am omnipresent. But I am here because of a wrong turn that must be RECTIFIED lest that elusive fox escape me once more!
lines.zh: : 我是神。我无处不在。但我来到这里，是因为拐错了一个弯，而这个弯必须被纠正，否则那只行踪诡秘的狐狸又要从我手里溜走！

lines.en: : I will catch you, pink bitch! And when I do, I will bleed the answers from you like I am the lamprey and you are the fish I’ve found to drink!
lines.zh: : 我会抓住你的，粉红婊子！等我抓住你，我要像七鳃鳗吸血一样，把答案从你身上榨出来——我就是七鳃鳗，而你就是我找到的那条可以喝的鱼！

lines.en: : Hi!
scene nodokaoutside13
scene nodokaoutside14
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Who the fuck are you and where is your third dimension?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈是谁，你的第三维在哪儿？！

lines.en: : I left it back at hoooooooome! Why are you so loud, Nodoka-chan?!
lines.zh: : 我把它落在家里啦！你为什么这么大声啊，Nodoka 酱？！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside15
: Drop your pleasantries and remind me why I’m here if we’re so familiar! The last thing I remember is a hole!
lines.zh: : 少来这套客套，既然我们这么熟，那你提醒我一下我为什么在这儿！我最后记得的只有一个洞！

lines.en: : We’re in the womb! Weren’t you listening to the narrator just now?
lines.zh: : 我们在子宫里呀！你刚才没在听旁白说话吗？

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} the narrator and I said no such thing! Are you a figment of my imagination or a paranormal entity I can fornicate with?! Answer me!
lines.zh: : 我就是旁白，而我没说过那种话！你是我臆想出来的幻影，{i}还是{/i}我可以为之通奸的超自然实体？！回答我！

lines.en: : F-F-Fornicate?! Right here?! Right now?!
lines.zh: : 通……通奸？！就在这儿？！就现在？！

lines.en: : How else am I supposed to make it until dawn?! If I’m going to hallucinate ghosts, you better damn believe I’m going to fuck them too!
lines.zh: : 不然我还能怎么熬到天亮？！既然我要幻觉出鬼来，那你最好他妈的相信我连它们一起操！

lines.en: : Nodoka-chan, relax! I’ll explain everything! The same way I always do!
lines.zh: : Nodoka 酱，冷静！我会把一切都解释清楚的！就像我一直以来那样！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside16
: What do you mean {i}always?{/i} Who are you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 「{i}一直以来{/i}」是什么意思？你到底是谁？

lines.en: : Ai-chan! The elusive fox you were talking about a minute ago? That’s me! And you came here to-
lines.zh: : Ai 酱呀！你一分钟前说的那只行踪诡秘的狐狸？就是我呀！而你来这儿是为了——

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside17
: Right! I remember everything now! You’re here to help me find the door!
lines.zh: : 对！我现在全想起来了！你是来帮我找那扇门的！

lines.en: : Wow! You’re getting so much better at this! It took you almost two minutes to remember who I was last time.
lines.zh: : 哇！你这方面进步好大！上次你花了差不多两分钟才记起我是谁。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Things have changed since then. I’ve been sucked into what my peers are referring to as some sort of indefinite apocalyptic rift in time and space. One that, for some reason, I’m now allowed to experience alongside them.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}从那以后事情变了。我被卷进了我的同龄人们所说的某种时空里无限期的末日裂隙。而因为某种原因，我现在被允许跟他们一起体验它。{/size}

lines.en: : But {i}why?{/i} The timing is odd. And if I am still able to find this layer of suspended reality and dream up the same demons who haunt my mother, how am I to believe that what those peers say is true?
lines.zh: : 可{i}为什么{/i}呢？时机太怪了。而且，如果我仍然能找到这层悬停的现实、并梦见那些缠着我母亲的同样的恶魔，那我凭什么相信那些同龄人说的话是真的？

lines.en: : That’s where {i}Ai{/i} comes in! It’s where {i}I{/i} come in!
lines.zh: : 这就是 {i}Ai{/i} 派上用场的地方！也就是{i}我{/i}派上用场的地方！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside18
: Spare me your swordplay, Ai-chan! Your name is far detached from the feelings I feel for you in this moment!
lines.zh: : 少跟我玩你的刀剑把戏，Ai 酱！你的名字跟我在这一刻对你的感觉差了十万八千里！

lines.en: : Nodoka-chan, you’ve already answered these questions yourself! In the past and in the future!
lines.zh: : Nodoka 酱，这些问题你自己早就回答过了！在过去，也在未来！

lines.en: : That compulsion you had to go to the library a few seconds ago wasn’t just so you could wait for sunrise! That was an echo of your past! A rumbling in your tummy to warn you that you’re hungry!
lines.zh: : 你几秒钟前非要去图书馆的那股冲动，不只是为了等日出！那是来自你过去的回声！是你肚子里的一阵咕噜，在警告你——你饿了！

lines.en: : I see. So I’ve left something in the {i}library{/i} that will fill in the gaps of my consciousness.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。也就是说，我在{i}图书馆{/i}里留下了某样东西，能填补我意识的空缺。

lines.en: : Hmm...maybe you’re {i}not{/i} getting any better at this? You normally at least know that you’re looking for something whenever you show up here.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许你这方面并{i}没有{/i}变好？你每次出现在这儿，起码至少知道自己是在找什么东西。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t really get how you got here {i}at all{/i} without knowing that. But I guess that doesn’t matter since the whole point of working as a team is helping each other!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我{i}完全{/i}搞不懂你连这个都不知道是怎么到这儿来的。不过我想那不重要了，毕竟团队合作的意义就是互相帮助嘛！

lines.en: : What do you get from {i}me{/i} then? Where does my benefit become a mutual one?
lines.zh: : 那你从我这儿得到什么？{i}我{/i}的好处在什么时候变成互相的？

lines.en: : I just love helping people! The smiles of my friends and family are the only things that can bring a smile to {i}my{/i} face! And I love smiling! Smile with me, Nodoka-chan!
lines.zh: : 我就是喜欢帮助别人！朋友和家人的笑容，是唯一能让{i}我{/i}脸上浮现笑容的东西！而我爱笑！跟我一起笑吧，Nodoka 酱！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside19
: You think I have time to {i}smile?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你以为我有时间{i}笑{/i}吗？！

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say you’re part of some sort of indefinite apocalypse rift or something?
lines.zh: : 你刚才不是说你卷进了某种无限期的末日裂隙之类的吗？

lines.en: : In essence, yes!
lines.zh: : 本质上，是的！

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that mean you have tons of time then?
lines.zh: : 那不就表示你有大把时间了吗？

lines.en: : {size=-4}Not here, you stupid fox! The context of this meeting implies I have limited time to accomplish whatever short-term goals will bring me closer to opening the door and now {i}you’re{/i} here padding the fucking word count instead of moving the plot forward!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}在这儿不是，你这蠢狐狸！这次见面的语境意味着，我只有有限的时间去完成那些能让我更接近打开那扇门的短期目标，而你现在却在这儿凑他妈的字数，而不是推进剧情！{/size}

lines.en: : Kyoko always hated when books dragged on too. You smart girls always make my brain hurt. I just want to have fun!
lines.zh: : Kyoko 一直讨厌书拖得太长。你们这些聪明的女孩总是让我脑壳疼。我只想开心一下！

lines.en: : Then show me where the fucking library is and go find a picture book or something!
lines.zh: : 那就告诉我那该死的图书馆在哪儿，然后自己去找本图画书什么的！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside20
: Okay! Here we are.
lines.zh: : 好啦！我们到了。

lines.en: : Where are all the lights?
lines.zh: : 灯都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : They haven’t worked here in centuries.
lines.zh: : 这儿的灯已经几百年没亮过了。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside21
: Centuries? You’ve been here that long?
lines.zh: : 几百年？你在这儿待了这么久？

lines.en: : Yup-yup! My existence is tied to yours, so I’m not allowed to leave until {i}you{/i} do! And whenever you’re not here, I’m just suspended in a state of physical and mental paralysis!
lines.zh: : 是呀是呀！我的存在跟{i}你{/i}的绑在一起，所以你走之前我不能离开！而每当你不在这儿的时候，我就只是被悬置在一种生理和心理的麻痹状态里！

lines.en: : Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 我怎么一点也不意外呢？

lines.en: : Because you made me say that!
lines.zh: : 因为是你让我这么说的！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside22
: In any event, I must find whatever information I left myself. It’s likely absolutely essential if I stashed it so deeply in the manifested depths of my mind.
lines.zh: : 无论如何，我必须找到我留给自己的那份资料。既然我把它藏得那么深、埋在心智的具象深处，那它多半是绝对重要的。

lines.en: : It definitely is! Your research has always been so important to you, Nodoka-chan! Which is why I’m so surprised that the memories of it seem to be slipping away!
lines.zh: : 当然是！你的研究对你一直那么重要，Nodoka 酱！所以看到关于它的记忆似乎正在溜走，我才这么吃惊！

lines.en: : I will whack you over the head with a wet floor sign if you so much as mention {i}slipping{/i} in my presence again.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢在我面前再提一次「{i}滑{/i}」，我就用湿地板警示牌砸你的头。

lines.en: : Please, no! Physical abuse is even worse than the mental kind! And that’s even more true when swordplay is involved!
lines.zh: : 拜托别！身体虐待比精神虐待还糟！而且要是还牵扯到刀剑把戏，那就更糟了！

lines.en: : The archives. Where are they? My gut is telling me that’s where I must go.
lines.zh: : 档案室。在哪儿？我的直觉告诉我，我必须去那儿。

lines.en: : To the left. But-
lines.zh: : 往左。不过——

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside23
: Hey! Aren’t you going to listen to my warning? It’s super-duper important!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你不听听我的警告吗？这超级无敌重要！

lines.en: : Bullshit! The only thing that’s important here is listening to the {i}real{/i} me instead of this personified {i}echo,{/i} just to hearken back to terminology {i}you{/i} used at {i}my{/i} omniscient behest, {i}fox.{/i}
lines.zh: : 放屁！这里唯一重要的，是听{i}真正{/i}的我自己说话，而不是听这个人格化的{i}回声{/i}——顺便用一下{i}你{/i}在{i}我{/i}全知的旨意下用过的术语，{i}狐狸{/i}。

lines.en: : You know, “fox” isn’t really a good insult, Nodoka-chan. Have you ever actually seen a fox in real life? They’re super cute and super funny!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，「狐狸」真算不上什么好骂人的话，Nodoka 酱。你在现实里真的见过狐狸吗？它们超级可爱、超级搞笑！

lines.en: : Yes, and so are sea urchins but you don’t see teenage girls snapping photos of them and posting them all over the fucking Internet.
lines.zh: : 是啊，海胆也很可爱，可你没见过十几岁的女孩给它们拍照、然后发满整个该死的互联网吧。

lines.en: : Okay, well we clearly have two very different definitions of what it means to be cute and funny. But still! You need to be careful when you’re in there!
lines.zh: : 好吧，我们俩对「可爱又搞笑」的定义显然天差地别。不过还是！你在里面的时候得当心！

lines.en: : Why? Are you tempted to stab me in the back or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你忍不住想背后捅我一刀之类的？

lines.en: : Of course not! There’s nothing Ai hates more than violence. There’s nothing {i}I{/i} hate more than violence!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！Ai 最讨厌的就是暴力。{i}我{/i}最讨厌的就是暴力！

lines.en: : But you and me aren’t the only ones who exist here, Nodoka-chan! This is a {i}school{/i} after all. There’s security all over the place to make sure nobody gets sodomized!
lines.zh: : 但这里存在的可不只你和我，Nodoka 酱！毕竟这是一所{i}学校{/i}。到处都有保安，确保没有人被鸡奸！

lines.en: : And they’ve been working overtime lately making sure nobody is walking around with uncensored ponytails. Do you like ponytails, Nodoka-chan?
lines.zh: : 而且他们最近在加班加点，确保没有人顶着未打码的马尾辫到处走。你喜欢马尾辫吗，Nodoka 酱？

lines.en: : Of course I do. It’s the most sexual haircut. But I’m not about to sit here and discuss why and how when there are {i}things{/i} for me to find!
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢。那是最性感的发型。但我可没工夫坐在这儿讨论为什么、怎么个好法——我还有{i}东西{/i}要找呢！

lines.en: : Totally understandable! I’ll just float over and keep myself occupied with a little song then.
lines.zh: : 完全理解！那我就飘到一边，唱个小曲儿自己打发时间好了。

lines.en: : Daaaaaaaisy, Daaaaaisy. Give me your answer, doooooooo.
lines.zh: : Daaaaaaaisy, Daaaaaisy. Give me your answer, doooooooo.

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside24
: Something less creepy and cliche! Why must I always distract myself from focusing on myself?!
lines.zh: : 来点不那么瘆人、不那么老套的！为什么我总是要把注意力从自己身上引开？！

lines.en: : That’s the only song I know! Shiori-chan always hogs the radio and we only get an hour each week!
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一会唱的歌！Shiori 酱老是霸占收音机，我们每周才轮到一个小时！

lines.en: : Am I supposed to care?! With the fate of whatever I’m supposed to be protecting hanging in the balance?!
lines.zh: : 我该在乎吗？！当我要保护的那个什么玩意的命运正悬于一线？！

lines.en: : You don’t even know?! Nodoka-chan, this is super bad! Your connection to the womb is hanging on by a thread at this point and not a whole umbilical cord!
lines.zh: : 你连那个都不知道？！Nodoka 酱，这下可糟了！你跟子宫的连接现在命悬一线，而且那还不是一整条脐带！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside25
: I know! Which is why it’s absolutely paramount that you-
lines.zh: : 我知道！所以你绝对——

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside26
: What’s this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside27
: What’s up? Did you find something? Is it {b}DRUGS?{/b}
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你找到什么了吗？是{b}毒品{/b}吗？

lines.en: : Better. It’s {i}information.{/i}
lines.zh: : 更好。是{i}信息{/i}。

lines.en: : Again, I just don’t think we’re ever going to see eye to eye on some things. What’s it say?
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我觉得我们在有些事上永远达不成共识。上面写了什么？

lines.en: : It says...
lines.zh: : 上面写着……

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokaoutside28
: Uhh...
: Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : It’s fucking pixellated. I can’t read it.
lines.zh: : 它他妈的是打了马赛克的。我读不了。

lines.en: : Oh! I can help with that!
lines.zh: : 哦！这个我能帮忙！

lines.en: : What? How?! Why? How? What?
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么帮？！为什么？怎么？什么？

lines.en: : I exist in the same part of your brain that you use to be creative! You know, the one that’s caught in a perpetual war against your logical side?
lines.zh: : 我存在于你大脑里用来创造的那个部分！你知道的，那个跟你逻辑的一侧打着永恒战争的部分？

lines.en: : And that side is also used to de-censor dialogue?
lines.zh: : 那一部分也能用来给对话去马赛克？

lines.en: : Nope! But if you use your imagination, you can make those words say anything you want them to!
lines.zh: : 不能！但只要你发挥想象力，你就能让那些字说出你想让它们说的任何话！

lines.en: : But that’s not-
lines.zh: : 可那不是——

lines.en: : Here! Let’s turn them into a happy message to brighten up your day!
lines.zh: : 来！我们把它们变成一条快乐的消息，点亮你这一天！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside29
: Oh, good! More cliche horror. Thank you very much, Ai-chan! This makes everything SO MUCH FUCKING BETTER!
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了！更多老套的恐怖。真是非常感谢，Ai 酱！这让一切都他妈的好多了！

lines.en: : At least there’s a smiley face! Nothing bad has ever happened with a- mpphhhfhfhfh??!!!??!!!
lines.zh: : 至少有个笑脸！凡是带笑脸的就从没出过坏事——唔呣呣呃呃呃？？！！！？？！！！

lines.en: : Use my imagination...I can change it! I just need to imagine what I’ve said {i}before!{/i}
lines.zh: : 用我的想象力……我能改它！我只需要想象我{i}以前{/i}说过什么！

lines.en: : {i}MMMMMMMMMNNNHHHHHFHFHFHFHFHFH!!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃！！！！！{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside30
: Can you {i}shut up?!{/i} I’m so close to...well, {i}something!{/i} But I can’t figure out what that {i}something{/i} is while you’re making silly background noises!
lines.zh: : 你能{i}闭嘴{/i}吗？！我就快……嗯，就快到{i}什么{/i}了！可你一直在发出傻乎乎的背景噪音，我没法搞清那个「{i}什么{/i}」是什么！

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside31
: Thank you...Now, let’s see here. I just need to-
lines.zh: : 谢谢……那么，让我看看。我只需要——

lines.en: : Oh. Well, fuck me I guess. There’s another page.
lines.zh: : 哦。行吧，操我吧我猜。还有一页。

lines.en: : To my past or present self — when the grass seems greener on the other side, what you’re seeing is chartreuse.
lines.zh: : 致过去或现在的我——当对面的草看起来更绿时，你看到的其实是黄绿色。

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside32
: Forget everything you know about landscaping and...pray for sand instead. Fear the {i}Gardener.{/i} The weeds have overgrown. And while they feed us in these times of need, they...
lines.zh: : 忘掉你所知道的关于造景的一切，然后……转而祈求沙子吧。畏惧{i}园丁{/i}。杂草已经疯长。虽然在这个匮乏的年代它们喂养着我们，但它们……

lines.en: scene nodokaoutside33
: ...are doused in poisons you would not believe even if I were to include comprehensive analyses of their chemical compositions and...the effects they have on girls like you.
lines.zh: : ……浸透了你不会相信的毒药，就算我把它们化学成分的全面分析、以及……它们对你这样的女孩产生的影响都写上去，你也不会相信。

lines.en: : The answers you seek are buried beneath your feet. The question you must ask now is how you’re meant to...dig?
lines.zh: : 你寻求的答案被埋在你脚下。你现在必须问的问题是，你该怎么……挖？

lines.en: : What? What was I-
lines.zh: : 什么？我刚才——
